Fields.Name: Disable Param - Network Test
Fields.Description: Parameters marked with  are excluded in the NT version package.

Fields.Name: Camera Dither Fade ID
Fields.Description: Camera fade parameter ID (-1 refer to material, 0: do not disappear, 1 parameter ID)

Fields.Name: Send Report - Animation Memory Size MB
Fields.Description: If this value is exceeded, a report will be sent by the reporting system.

Fields.Name: Is No Ray Tracing
Fields.Description: Would you like to register for the ray tracing scene? (1: Do not register 0: Register)

Fields.Name: Ray Tracing Culling Mode
Fields.Description: The culling mode applied during ray tracing rendering. If set to Automatic, the default value set in the program will be used.

Fields.Name: Ray Tracing BLAS Rebuild Type
Fields.Description: Ray tracing BLAS rebuild settings. If set to Automatic, the default values ​​set in the program will be used. Rebuilding needs to be enabled for large objects like bosses or objects that zoom in and cover the camera.
